name: newms-plugins
description: Personal plugin set: discipline, dev pipeline, danxbot orchestration

plugins.name: base
plugins.description: Universal discipline: shell discipline (exit capture, polling, tool choice, process kill), live time injection, safety deny-guards. Install everywhere.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Code-writing discipline: read-only-by-default debugging/investigation with a fix-mode switch (TDD included), code quality, git safety. Install on instances that write code.

plugins.name: human-collaboration
plugins.description: Human-in-the-loop discipline: read-only-default (human-loop skill), diagnostic behaviour-fix skill (docs). Install only where a human drives prompts. Do NOT install on autonomous dispatched workers (diagnostic-mode-on-question would deadlock).

plugins.name: danxbot
plugins.description: Danxbot orchestrator: dispatch architecture, runtime modes, deploy, the shared issue-card-workflow skill (used by dispatched workers and operator sub-agents alike), danx-chat/danx-ideate, issue-blocker. Single home for everything danxbot-related — install on every danxbot-aware instance + workspace.
